Beginner.learningGoal: Encode and decode simple models with JSONEncoder and JSONDecoder.
gotchas: Missing keys throw DecodingError.keyNotFound unless the property is optional
JSONEncoder output key order is not stable unless outputFormatting includes sortedKeys
Date and Data need an explicit strategy
goodSolutionShows: Plain Codable structs with synthesized conformance
sortedKeys formatting in tests for stable output
Round-trip test (encode then decode equals original)

Intermediate.learningGoal: Customise keys and values with CodingKeys, date strategies and optional / default fields.
gotchas: Snake_case keys need convertFromSnakeCase or CodingKeys
Decoding a missing optional is nil but a null-typed mismatch throws
Date decoding strategy mismatches silently produce errors
goodSolutionShows: Optional vs default value for missing fields via custom init(from:)
Decoding errors surfaced with clear context
shapeHints: decoding API payloads with snake_case keys
a model with defaulted missing fields
ISO 8601 dates decoded from a fixed string

Advanced.learningGoal: Write custom Encodable/Decodable with nested containers and polymorphic payloads.
gotchas: Unkeyed container order matters and decoding must consume elements
Polymorphic decoding needs a discriminator key
Nested containers must be created for each level or keys are lost
goodSolutionShows: Enum with associated values encoded with a type tag
shapeHints: a Shape enum encoded as { type, payload }
flattening a nested JSON structure into a flat model
decoding a heterogeneous array of events
